doc: Rivet's sprint and dodge roll as data (rivet-motion, 2026-11-03 eve). Ticks are 60 Hz frames. Sprint (owner call C19: a held key) raises the top speed above the 5.0 m/s tackle line (bodies.json rivet run_mps) while the stick points within min_forward_dot of the facing; the facing then follows the walk at turn_dps, not the aim. The roll is a press: roll_m covered in roll_ticks on an ease-out curve along the stick (or the facing), invulnerable from iframe_from to iframe_to (inclusive), then recovery_ticks with the stick scaled by recovery_move_scale; no new roll until cooldown_ticks after the recovery. The live tuning panel edits these rows.
